content.title: What celebrities are at Coachella 2026? See who we've spotted so far
content.text: April 10, 2026Updated April 12, 2026, 6:42 p.m. PTCoachella 2026 festivalgoers should have more than their ears on alert — they should also have their eyes peeled for any celebrities wandering about the Empire Polo Club grounds this weekend.Some of last year’s famous attendees included Timothée Chalamet and Kylie Jenner, Justin and Hailey Bieber, Dylan Efron, and Nina Dobrev and Shaun White. So, who could show up this year?Here are some of the actors, social media personalities and other recognizable names that have been spotted on and around the Empire Polo Club grounds in Indio during Weekend 1. Katy Perry and Justin TrudeauThe former Prime Minister of Canada and his newly public girlfriend, pop star Katy Perry, were bopping along to Bieber's headlining performance Saturday, and they posted some funny content to social media.Timothee ChalametWe heard news that his famous girlfriend, Kylie Jenner, was here Friday, but on Saturday, we got confirmation that Timmy accompanied Jenner to Coachella 2026.Chalamet was quite bundled up Saturday night, perhaps hoping to disguise himself and avoid too much commotion from festivalgoers as he had a bandana covering most of his face with a camouflage baseball cap pulled down close over his eyes. But if he really wanted to be incognito, he probably shouldn't have stood behind his girlfriend while wearing a cap that is tied to merch from his movie "Marty Supreme."Jacob Elordi"Euphoria" and "Wuthering Heights" star Jacob Elordi was also spotted jamming to Bieber on Saturday night. The hot throb actor was singing along to all the words at Bieber's show while wearing a "SWAG" baseball cap, the name of Bieber's latest album. Since he's already here, Elordi has a chance to really blow people's mind if he showed up to the special "Euphoria" screening Sunday night at Coachella in the festival camp grounds.Sabrina CarpenterThere's a rumor going around the desert that Sabrina Carpenter has been rehearsing her Coachella set at Acrisure Arena in Palm Desert for the past several days. We reached out to the arena and they were not able to confirm nor deny — so we'll leave that one up to your interpretation.Still need your Sabrina fix? Head to Sabrina's Pit Stop on your way into the festival.RoséBlackpink’s Rosé showed love for Sabrina Carpenter on her Instagram story. The “APT.” singer shared a clip of her singing and dancing to “Espresso" in the crowd, and in another post, called Carpenter a queen.Teyana TaylorOscar-nominated actress Teyana Taylor stunned on the red carpet throughout the awards season for her role in “One Battle After Another.” Unsurprisingly, she stunned at Coachella, too. She showed off her festival look to People in a post shared on Instagram.Karol GColombian singer-songwriter Karol G will close out Coachella on April 12 and April 19, and she is the first Latina to headline the festival.“Karol G is everything,” Local DJ and rapper J. Patron (Camilo Gomez) and Gasolina party series founder Sal Moreno told The Desert Sun earlier this spring. “You can’t get any bigger than headlining Coachella, so the fact she’s doing it is just huge for the culture, huge for the music, and just huge for any artist that has a dream to play that spot in the future.”Kylie Jenner “Keeping Up with the Kardashians” star Kylie Jenner started sharing Instagram stories about prepping for Coachella the day before the festival, including a shot of some stylish nails with flower gems she said gave “bieberchella” vibes. She also posted a photo of herself posing with an iced coffee, captioned “chelly day 1!!!!!” Kourtney KardashianKourtney Kardashian is in the desert for her Camp Poosh. She’s also promoting her supplement brand, Lemme, according to her Instagram story.Bowen Yang and Matt Rogers“Las Culturistas” podcast co-hosts Bowen Yang and Matt Rogers are at Coachella. Yang also posted on his Instagram story a picture of Addison Rae, who is among this year’s performers.Paris HiltonOn Instagram, media personality and socialite Paris Hilton shared a series of stories showing her making her way to (and later at) Coachella Weekend 1."So we're about to take off. I'm so excited for Coachella this weekend," Hilton said in one of the videos earlier in the week, while also showing her personal skincare merchandise, Parívie.Victoria JusticeDon’t “Freak the Freak Out,” but Victoria Justice is at Coachella 2026. She posted a selfie on her Instagram story captioned "Day 1" and shared a different post of her singing along to song in a packed crowd.Jesse McCartneyIt’s officially the best day of our lives. A Desert Sun staff member spotted Jesse McCartney walking toward the Outdoor Theatre stage VIP area on the Coachella festival grounds, and although he was wearing a green bandana (along with a very interesting jacket that's what originally made her notice him), he pulled down his bandana to say hi to a nearby fan and that's how she was able to confirm it was Mr. "Beautiful Soul" himself.Corey FogelmanisCorey Fogelmanis of “Girl Meets World” was a surprise guest during his former co-star’s headlining set. He posted to his Instagram story a video of Sabrina Carpenter performing with the caption “unreal spectacular vivacious” in his post, a nod to the fact that he played the brief role of a waiter during Susan Sarandon's monologue (aka while Carpenter was doing a costume change).'Love Island' starsThe popular reality dating show has met Coachella: A group of "Love Island" season 7 stars, including, Jeremiah Brown, Iris Kendall, TJ Palma, Hannah Fields, and Andreina Santos, posted a series of Instagram stories about a "prechella" hang.Ariana MadixSpeaking of "Love Island," when two Desert Sun journalists were in line waiting to get their media credential and GA wristband Thursday evening they looked to their left and, lo and behold, just one line over was "Love Island" host and "Vanderpump Rules" star Ariana Madix.The reality TV personality — who's also an author, actress and co-owner of the Los Angeles sandwich shop Something About Her — was in line with longtime boyfriend Daniel Wai and a friend to pick up their own wristbands.Reality TV stars, they're just like us!Becky GSinger Becky G said she kicked of her Coachella weekend with a stop at Sixth Street Coffee in Coachella (where she's surprised local fans in the past during the festival) and Las Tres Conchitas Bakery.She was then spotted on Friday dancing among the crowd near Do LaB stage as DJ Fifi performed.She held a sign that read “I know the DJ," as festivalgoers rushed in to snap pics along side her.Liv Morgan, Raquel Rodriguez, CJ Perry and JoJo OffermanThe world of WWE comes to Coachella thanks to Liv Morgan, Raquel Rodriguez, CJ Perry and JoJo Offerman, who showed how they spent their Day 1 of Weekend 1 in a joint Instagram post.Justine Skye and Hailey BieberJustine Skye and Hailey Bieber posted on Instagram that they were ready for Coachella, and we're not surprised, seeing as Hailey's husband is headlining the festival Saturday. Delilah Belle Hamlin Professional fashion model and influencer Delilah Belle Hamlin also shared she was headed to the festival’s first weekend. "Indio I am in you," she wrote in an Instagram story.Daniela AvanziniDaniela Avanzini, singer, dancer, and member of the global girl group KATSEYE, posted a series of Instagram stories saying she’d be partaking in Weekend 1 fun, which makes sense seeing as she and her bandmates are making their Coachella debut Friday.Alix Earle TikTok personality Alix Earle shared that she would be attending Weekend 1 in an Instagram reel showing her and her friends enjoying "Day 0," aka the Thursday before Coachella officially starts.Kendall JennerIt looks like Kendall Jenner is in the desert. She reposted a clip of a sweet embrace she shared with her sisters, Kylie Jenner and Kourtney Kardashian, and in the background was her 818 Tequila brand. The 818 Outpost returned to the desert for another year.Winnie HarlowCanadian fashion model Winnie Harlow shared she was on her way to Coachella aboard "Sliv Air.""Sliving my way to Coachella Valley," Harlow wrote on Instagram .Young MikoPuerto Rican rapper and singer-songwriter Young Miko performed at a YSL Beauty’s Coachella pre-party "Drive-thru" event Thursday night amid rumors swirling she may be making an appearance on stage sometime during Weekend 1 (potentially with Karol G?).TinasheTinashe, who is on Saturday's lineup, was a surprise guest for Disco Lines' Thursday night special Day 0 set in the Coachella campgrounds.EjaeEarlier this week, Ejae, aka the singing voice of Rumi in the award-winning Netflix film "KPop Demon Hunters," was spotted rehearsing the hit "Golden" along side KATSEYE. Then, she did indeed come out with the global girl group as speculated to sing the Oscar-winning song during KATSEYE's Coachella debut Friday, and she brought fellow HUNTR/X singers Audrey Nuna (the singing voice of Mira), and Rei Ami (the singing voice of Zoey),James CharlesBeauty influencer James Charles shared with fans that he was Coachella ready with his on point "Day 1 Outfit."Editor's note: The Desert Sun will be updating this list as we learn of more celebrity sightings.
